name: FIAP Fase 3 - Oficina (Observabilidade)
description: Latencia, erros, throughput, CPU/mem K8s, healthchecks e metricas de negocio (OS).

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(duration)*1000 AS 'latencia media (ms)' FROM Transaction WHERE appName='fiap-app' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentile(duration*1000, 95) AS p95, percentile(duration*1000, 99) AS p99 FROM Transaction WHERE appName='fiap-app' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT rate(count(*), 1 minute) AS 'req/min' FROM Transaction WHERE appName='fiap-app' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) AS 'erro %' FROM Transaction WHERE appName='fiap-app' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT average(duration)*1000 AS 'ms' FROM Transaction WHERE appName='fiap-app' FACET name LIMIT 10
SELECT count(*) FROM TransactionError WHERE appName='fiap-app' FACET error.message, transactionName LIMIT 20

pages.name: Kubernetes (Infra)
pages.description: CPU/memoria dos pods, replicas e saude.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(cpuUsedCores) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE containerName='fiap-app' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT average(memoryUsedBytes) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE containerName='fiap-app' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT uniqueCount(podName) AS 'pods' FROM K8sPodSample WHERE deploymentName='fiap-app' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT uniqueCount(podName) FROM K8sPodSample WHERE namespace='oficina' FACET status

pages.name: Negocio (Ordens de Servico)
pages.description: Metricas de negocio derivadas das transacoes e logs.

widgets.title: Volume de OS criadas por dia

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'OS criadas' FROM Transaction WHERE appName='fiap-app' AND request.method='POST' AND name LIKE '%OrdensServico%' AND request.method='POST' TIMESERIES 1 day SINCE 7 days ago

widgets.title: Latencia media por endpoint de OS (proxy de tempo por etapa)

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT average(duration)*1000 AS 'ms' FROM Transaction WHERE appName='fiap-app' AND name LIKE '%OrdensServico%' FACET name LIMIT 15
SELECT count(*) AS 'erros' FROM TransactionError WHERE appName='fiap-app' TIMESERIES AUTO
SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE service='fiap-auth-lambda' OR message LIKE '%Token emitido%' TIMESERIES AUTO
